subject: Post-call: QuestLine trial data handoff and evaluation playbook
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@questline.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@questline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: QuestLine trial data handoff and evaluation playbook

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can keep momentum toward the 3-week trial we discussed. High-level goal: validate Redwood inference on QuestLine customer support prompts and measure accuracy/latency/cost tradeoffs against your current system.

Summary of success criteria (what we'll measure during the POC):
- Functional: >= 85% macro accuracy on a stratified sample of intent classification + median generation ROUGE>=0.6 for canned-response tasks (we can finalize metrics once we see labels).
- Performance: 95th pct latency < 400ms for 256-token requests at steady-state batching profile we discussed.
- Cost: baseline comparison against your current infra (tokens per session and $/M tokens).

Data we need from QuestLine for the initial evaluation:
1) Prompt/log export (anonymized): ~5,000–10,000 representative rows covering high/medium/low frequency intents. Fields we recommend: prompt_id, user_message, convo_context (optional), expected_response, label/intents (if available), sample_priority (high/med/low).
2) A smaller gold set (250–500 rows) with trusted expected_response for automated scoring.
3) Any post-processing rules you currently apply (regexes, sanitizers) and a short list of common failure cases.

Delivery options (pick one):
- S3 bucket share (preferred). We can provide a cross-account role for secure ingestion.
- Encrypted archive via secure transfer (we accept KMS-encrypted .csv.gz).
- Secure upload to a pre-shared Google Drive folder (for small samples).

Initial timeline (proposed):
- Day 0 (this week): QuestLine exports sample and gold set + export manifest.
- Day 2–3: Redwood confirms schema, performs quick sanity checks and shares ingest credentials/playbook.
- Week 1: Full data transfer + ingest into Redwood staging for eval runs.
- Week 2: Run evaluation suite and share initial report.
- Week 3: Tune model variant / quantization profile and demo results + go/no-go decision.

Ownership (what we each own):
- QuestLine: data export, redaction/anonymization (Alex), point of contact for clarifications (Priya).
- Redwood: ingest and eval pipeline (Soojin), performance runs and model recommendations (Karthik), onboarding and trial coordination (Marissa).

Next steps for you (Alex/Priya):
1) Send a small sample CSV (200–500 rows) and the gold set if available by EOD Friday 2028-06-09 so we can validate schema.
2) Indicate preferred delivery method (S3 cross-account / encrypted archive / Drive).
3) Note any PI/regulated fields that require extra handling (we will provide redaction guidance).

Attachment: sample schema & redaction guidance stub.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up if helpful.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): redaction_guidance_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@questline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@questline.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuestLine trial data handoff and evaluation playbook

Thanks, Soojin — great summary. We'll aim to get the sample over by Friday. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) For the gold set, is it acceptable if responses are anonymized (we'll remove user identifiers) but keep intent labels?
2) Do you have a preferred CSV schema/column ordering? Attaching a 300-row sample export (anonymized) and a quick transfer checklist.

We plan to use the S3 cross-account option. Please send the role ARN and desired bucket path and we can initiate the bucket policy change on our side. Also, confirm whether you require KMS encryption at rest for ingest.

We'll attach the files and follow up with Priya if there are any regulatory fields to redact.

—
Alex Thompson
Head of ML Ops, QuestLine
alex.thompson@questline.ai | +1 (617) 555-0124

Attachment(s): questline_prompt_sample_export.csv (CSV), s3_transfer_playbook.txt (TXT)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@questline.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@questline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuestLine trial data handoff and evaluation playbook

Alex — perfect, thanks for the sample. Quick answers inline and a couple of small tweaks to make ingestion smooth: 

1) Gold set: anonymized responses are fine as long as the mapping from prompt_id -> expected_response is preserved. Intents are highly useful.
2) Schema: we prefer CSV columns: prompt_id, user_message, convo_context, expected_response, intent_label, priority, created_at. We can accept additional columns but please include a manifest CSV describing them.
3) KMS: we require server-side encryption; cross-account role + SSE-KMS is our standard. We'll provide a role ARN and a short policy snippet by EOD; your S3 team can attach the policy and we'll assume ReadObject privileges on the provided prefix only.

Redaction guidance (quick notes):
- Remove PII at field level (names, phone numbers, SSNs) or replace with tokenized placeholders (e.g., <NAME_1>).
- Preserve sentence structure where possible for evaluation quality (don’t truncate entire sentences).
- If you must remove a field, include column-level note in the manifest.

Minimums and quality checks:
- Minimum recommended sample size: 2,500 rows for representative baseline; we can work with 500 but expect higher variance.
- Include at least 5 examples per medium/low-frequency intent in the gold set if possible.

I'll drop the role ARN and a small ingest playbook link here in the thread once it's live. Karthik / Marissa: we should schedule the trial kickoff call for Tue 2028-06-13 to coordinate the transfer and run the first ingest. Are you available?

—
Soojin

Attachment(s): none (referenced: s3_transfer_playbook.txt provided by QuestLine)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@questline.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@questline.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuestLine trial data handoff and evaluation playbook

Thanks, all — quick logistics note: I’ve booked a 30-minute kickoff for Tue 2028-06-13 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite to follow). Agenda: review transfer access, validate schema, confirm gold set, and agree on scoring thresholds and reporting cadence.

Action owners before kickoff: 
- QuestLine (Alex): provide cross-account S3 access on prefix /redwood-questline/poc/ + upload sample/gold set by Mon EOD 2028-06-11.
- Redwood (Soojin): share role ARN + ingest playbook and the scoring rubric draft by Mon EOD 2028-06-11.
- Redwood (Karthik): prepare the initial model variants we'll test and a short resource plan for compute.

If those timelines work for you, we’ll proceed to ingest on Tue and target initial eval report by Fri 2028-06-16.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0248
